newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Modelo '97 exports seen up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Modelo '97 exports seen up 25 pct.

text.p: Mexico's leading brewer, Grupo Modelo SA, expects exports to increase by 25 percent in 1997, reaching record levels for the second consecutive year, a company source said on Wednesday.

"The calculations are that we can maintain a export growth rate of around 25 percent this year, on the base of the 29 percent that (exports) increased by last year," the source, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters, quoting official company forecasts.
Modelo sold a record 3.7 million hectoliters of beer outside of Mexico last year. This year it is aiming for 4.5 million hectoliters "or perhaps a little more," the source said.

Modelo exports five of its 10 brands: Corona, Negra Modelo, Pacifico, Modelo Especial and Corona Light. Considered one of the 10 largest brewers in the world, its exports represent a little more than 16 percent of total sales.
Modelo has 700 distributors in the United States, its principal export destination, but it is now making inroads in less traditional markets.
Russia doubled its consumption of Corona Extra in 1996, and growth in Asia is taking off, especially in Japan, Malaysia, Korea and China. The next targets are Honduras and Venezuela, the source said.
